run_nle_play_human: run the NLE play script in human mode to interactively play NetHack in the terminal
run_nle_play_random: run the NLE play script in random mode to auto-play NetHack with random actions
run_nle_play_wizard: run the NLE play script with wizard mode enabled for debugging NetHack gameplay
run_nle_play_nogames: run the NLE play script with multiple games to auto-restart NetHack after each episode
run_nle_play_raw: run the NLE play script with the raw environment to get unprocessed NetHack observations
